description: This PHP class 'Education' extends 'NormalizableDTO' and provides functionality to represent and normalize education-related data for an employee. It interacts with an ORM to retrieve employee education records and converts this data into an array format based on specified fields.

classes.name: Education
classes.description: Represents an employee's education data and provides normalization to array format based on specified fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Education DTO with the employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the education data into an array based on the provided fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of field names to getter methods for retrieving data.
